head.title: Milhojas Pastry Lover · Colombian Desserts in Naples, FL
head.description: Milhojas Pastry Lover, Naples FL: Colombian dessert trailer serving milhoja, oblea, cholado and tres leches. 5.0 rating on Google, 23 reviews. Call +1 239-397-7949.
head.og_description: Colombian desserts made fresh: milhoja, oblea, cholado, merengon and tres leches. 5.0 on Google.

jsonld.description: Colombian dessert food trailer in Naples, FL serving milhoja, oblea, cholado, merengon and tres leches.

parrafo.es: Milhojas Pastry Lover es el food trailer rosa que trae los postres colombianos de siempre a Naples: milhoja, oblea, cholado, merengon y tres leches, con el dulce de leche y los merengues hechos en casa por la dueña.
parrafo.en: Milhojas Pastry Lover is the pink food trailer bringing classic Colombian desserts to Naples: milhoja, oblea, cholado, merengon and tres leches, with homemade dulce de leche and meringues made by the owner.

hero.imagen_alt: Trailer rosa de Milhojas Pastry Lover con su logo

parrafo_1.es: Milhojas Pastry Lover recorre Naples en su trailer rosa sirviendo los postres colombianos clasicos: milhoja de hojaldre con crema, oblea tradicional, cholado y merengon, llenos de fruta fresca.
parrafo_1.en: Milhojas Pastry Lover travels around Naples in its pink trailer serving classic Colombian desserts: puff pastry milhoja with cream, traditional oblea, cholado and merengon, loaded with fresh fruit.

parrafo_2.es: La mayoria de los ingredientes son caseros: el dulce de leche y los merengues los hace la propia dueña, y se nota en cada reseña de 5 estrellas.
parrafo_2.en: Most of the ingredients are homemade: the owner makes the dulce de leche and the meringues herself, and it shows in every 5-star review.

items.quote: Absolutely delicious! Everything from Milhojas Pastry Lover is fresh, beautifully made, and tastes amazing. Definitely a must try if you're looking for a sweet treat. Highly recommend!
The service was great and everything looked so wonderful. I had the tres leches with mixed berry mousse. I loved the blackberry sauce! It was very refreshing.
Absolutely delicious Colombian desserts! The cholado, merengon, oblea, and milhoja were all amazing and full of flavor. Most of the ingredients are homemade by the owner.
